description:
Meridian Holdings has three subsidiaries whose individual financial statements are provided in separate sheets: Alpha Inc (manufacturing), Beta Corp (professional services), and Gamma LLC (distribution). The workbook also contains an 'Intercompany' sheet listing all intercompany transactions between subsidiaries, and a 'Prior_Year' sheet with last year's consolidated figures.

Create a consolidated financial statement workbook that:

1. Adds a 'Consolidated' sheet that combines all three subsidiaries' income statements and balance sheets, properly eliminating all intercompany revenue, cost, and balance sheet items listed in the Intercompany sheet. Use cell references to the subsidiary sheets and the elimination amounts — do not hardcode values.

2. Adds a 'Financial_Ratios' sheet calculating from the consolidated figures: Current Ratio, Quick Ratio, Debt-to-Equity Ratio, Gross Margin %, Operating Margin %, Net Margin %, Return on Equity (ROE), and Return on Assets (ROA). Each ratio must reference the Consolidated sheet.

3. Adds a 'Variance_Analysis' sheet comparing each consolidated income statement line item to the Prior_Year sheet, showing dollar variance and percentage variance for each line.

4. Applies conditional formatting to the variance percentage column: red background for unfavorable variances exceeding 10%, green background for favorable variances exceeding 10%.

5. Adds a 'Dashboard' sheet with a grouped bar chart comparing current year vs prior year for Revenue, Gross Profit, Operating Income, and Net Income.

Save the completed workbook.

metadata.data_source: Financial statement data based on real SEC EDGAR filing patterns for mid-cap holding companies
